Current report TeX is scientifically unchanged; delivery evidence was corrected by an actual cached rebuild and current-root inspection of all five final report pages.

findings.reason: Theorem 4 applies to every smoothly bounded pseudoconvex finite-type domain; it does not impose the KE assumption of the main theorem. E_m={|z|^(2m)+|w|^2<1} is admissible, and its monomial beta integral gives the exact displayed kernel. The unit-normal convention at (0,1) makes p=|z|^(2m)/2 and 1-|w|^2=epsilon^(2m)(2+|V|^(2m))+o(epsilon^(2m)). For m=2 the normalized |V|^2 coefficient is 2sqrt(2)/pi^2, rather than 4/pi^2. This is a genuine false printed coefficient, not a main-theorem counterexample. Substitution s=-2rho t forces eta=2^(-1/r)V; the Gaussian model independently shows depth 1/2, since the printed depth-1 identification differs by a factor 8.

Every leading derivative and the homogeneous Delta p commutator must be evaluated in the same eta variable. Its degree r-2 gives the same total weight, so after the arbitrary-variable renaming the universal equation (5.2) survives. The valuation bracket expands to 4k^3+32k^2+79k+60 and is nonzero for k>=1. The determinant has at most log degree 3 at the first relevant order, whereas the right side has the fourth power with coefficient proportional to b3^4. The radial-model gamma reduction has difference -(r-2)^2/(4r^2), giving r=2. These checks retain the imported microlocal all-orders and external uniformization dependencies; they are not a new proof of those inputs.

The projection has infinite rank because polynomials already give infinitely many independent square-integrable holomorphic functions. Its Hilbert-Schmidt norm squared is sum 1=infinity. Interior smoothness and local L2 are valid replacements; the later interior operations are unaffected.
For u=1-sum|z_j|^2 the coordinate-frame block determinant is (-1)^n while J(u)=1. The missing sign is a true general-dimensional defect; the actual n=2 calculation is unchanged.
